A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide a new perspective on load scheduling in smart grid by taking into account the structural properties of the system.

we provide an optimal solution for the load scheduling problem in the smart grids with unknown dynamics, while the existing works either provide sub-optimal solutions or require complete knowledge of the dynamics.
we have developed a new online algorithm for load scheduling in smart grid systems, which can learn the dynamics of the system and adapt its load scheduling policy in an online fashion.

, by carefully exploiting the structural properties of the system dynamics, the proposed load scheduling policy can achieve optimal performance in the face of unknown dynamics.

, by taking advantage of the structural properties exhibited in the system dynamics, it is possible to design efficient algorithms for load scheduling even when the statistics of the dynamics are unknown.
